description: CHICAGO – Illinois Attorney General-elect Kwame Raoul issued the following statement regarding a federal judge’s decision finding the entire Affordable Care Act unconstitutional: “The District Court’s decision jeopardizes healthcare access for more than one million Illinoisans, including children, seniors and people with pre-existing conditions.
